title: Arrow of Undead Slaying
summary: Targets Undead creatures only. Doubles the weapon damage against that creature type. The slaying effect has no saving throw.

fields.Activation: Action. Fire from a ranged weapon and consume one arrow. Range 60 ft.
fields.Effect: Targets Undead creatures only. Doubles the weapon damage against that creature type. The slaying effect has no saving throw.
fields.Restrictions: Special arrows cannot be used with off-hand ranged attacks.
fields.Crafting: Special arrows are obtained from loot or vendors.
fields.Creative use: Save this arrow for a confirmed Undead target.
fields.Base value: 20 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 activation, effects and linked rules.
